text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan (Perbekalan) (No. 2) 2024.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2025

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi empat ratus juta

satu ratus tiga puluh empat ribu ringgit (RM400,134,000) daripada

Kumpulan Wang Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan bagi tahun 2025 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 138,637,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 143,549,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 11,902,000

Perbelanjaan lain 42,942,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 63,104,000

JUMLAH 400,134,000

Dibuat 12 Disember 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/28/9(6); PN(PU2)747/III]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM (SUPPLY) (NO. 2) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1)

of the Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance System

(Supply) (No. 2) Regulations 2024.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2025

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding four hundred million one hundred thirty four

thousand ringgit (RM400,134,000) from the Employment Insurance Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Employment Insurance System

for the year 2025 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 138,637,000

Supplies and services 143,549,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 11,902,000

Other expenditures 42,942,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 63,104,000

TOTAL 400,134,000

Made 12 December 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/28/9(6); PN(PU2)747/III]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

Minister of Human Resources
